CustomField.label: Lifecycle Phase
CustomField.description: Trimmed to the 3 values actually produced (InitializeDealLifecycleCommandHandler sets Registration; ImplementationCommandService.advanceLifecyclePhase sets Implementation/Customer Success). "Protection" and "Sales Execution" were never removed as dead per se - those modules exist (Deal_Protection_Grant__c, DealOpportunityReconciliationBatch) but never advance this field - see project memory for that open follow-up decision. "Discovery"/"Review"/"Renewal"/"Completed"/"Archived" correspond to phases with no built module yet.
